basis: Defined by Neorickettsia infection; no specific organ damage established across this umbrella.
Congenital defect of the diaphragm, a skeletal muscle; common intrinsic pulmonary damage is not established for anterior hernias.
Tuberculous infection of lymph nodes; lymph-node involvement does not itself establish blood or marrow disease.
Melanoma originating in the digestive tract; hepatic sites are a minority subtype, not a shared feature.
Carcinoma originating in bladder urothelium; lymphoepithelioma-like morphology does not indicate lymphoma.
Benign ovarian epithelial-stromal neoplasm; reproductive location without a defining endocrine disorder.
Malignant tumor arising in the anus; skeletal muscle differentiation describes histology rather than another affected organ.
Congenital lower-limb joint contractures define the condition; no direct neurologic disease is established.
Primary breast carcinoma; breast has no axis, and metastatic organ damage is not inherent to this site-defined concept.
Ocular-only Stickler phenotype with vitreous abnormalities, myopia and retinal detachment; hearing impairment 4/28 is below 30%.
Congenital skeletal myopathy with biopsy abnormalities; aminotransferase elevations do not establish liver damage, and constipation alone adds no axis.
Primary microcephaly with intellectual disability; strabismus 4/6, optic nerve hypoplasia and microphthalmia each 2/6. Individual renal defects are below 30%.
Isolated spermatogenic failure with abnormal sperm morphology and infertility; no demonstrated endocrine dysfunction.
Congenital uterine shape abnormality confined to the reproductive system.
TCF20-related neurodevelopmental disorder; scoliosis in 1/2 annotated patients supports skeletal involvement, although the denominator is small.
Neoplasm of the rectum; lymphoma is only one possible subtype and does not justify an immune label for the umbrella.
Chromophobe renal cell carcinoma arising in the kidney; eosinophilic refers to tumor-cell appearance.
Primary carcinoma of the prostate, a reproductive organ; urinary tract invasion is not a defining or established common feature.
Immune dysfunction with chronic Candida infection of skin, nails and mucosa, including oral mucosa; an unspecified metabolic annotation adds no axis.
Dental malocclusion and impaired skeletal growth define the syndrome; no evidence establishes an endocrine cause of short stature.
Acute leukemia of megakaryocytic lineage involving marrow and blood; leukemia alone does not imply an immune mechanism label.
Congenital muscular dystrophy with intellectual impairment in most type B forms; ocular and cardiac damage are not established across most patients.
Purine synthesis disorder with neurodegeneration and deafness; optic atrophy with visual loss in 80-99%. Recurrent infections in 80-99% omitted because of the four-axis cap.
Immune-mediated lichen planus producing persistent hypertrophic skin plaques and possible scarring; no common extracutaneous damage established.
Defining abnormalities are lower-limb ectrodactyly, mandibular hypoplasia and congenital structural heart disease.
